name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 75% opacity. This keeps the ring visible against dark backgrounds while staying subtle enough not to distract. The thinner line balances visibility with minimal visual clutter, which matters for users who rely on focus indicators to navigate. Trade-off: it’s slightly less bold than a 3px ring, but that’s acceptable since the 1px white stroke already boosts contrast.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring still risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on *very* light backgrounds where the white stroke loses contrast against the background. A 3px ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity would hold contrast better across all backgrounds while keeping the indicator clear for keyboard users. Test with a 1:3 contrast ratio checker on both dark and light modes to settle it.
